home.title_en: School of Advanced Manufacturing and Robotics, Peking University, Tenured Professor, PhD Supervisor, Head of the Industrial Physics Intelligence Laboratory.
home.title_zh: 北京大学先进制造与机器人学院机器人科学与工程系，长聘教授，博士生导师，工业物理智能实验室负责人。
home.affiliation_zh:
庞智博_北京大学先进制造与机器人学院
‪Zhibo Pang‬ - ‪Google 学术搜索‬

bio.en: We are a frontier research team co-founded by master’s and PhD researchers from Peking University, Tsinghua University, Stanford University, the University of California, Berkeley, and the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences. Our core members have long cultivated deep expertise in embodied intelligence, world models, and robot learning, and are dedicated to building next-generation intelligent systems for the real physical world.
bio.zh: 我们是一支由北京大学、清华大学、斯坦福大学、加州大学伯克利分校及中国科学院自动化研究所硕博士研究人员共同组建的前沿科研团队，核心成员长期深耕具身智能、世界模型与机器人学习，致力于构建面向真实物理世界的下一代智能系统。

bio.en: We focus on developing next-generation embodied intelligent systems for the real physical world. We aim to build embodied world models capable of understanding spatial structures, perceiving physical interactions, predicting environmental dynamics, and sustaining continuous learning through action — endowing robots with authentic perception, reasoning, prediction, and interaction capabilities for the real world.
bio.zh: 致力于研究面向真实物理世界的下一代具身智能系统。我们希望构建能够理解空间结构、感知物理交互、预测环境变化，并通过行动持续学习的具身世界模型，使机器人真正具备对现实世界的感知、推理、预测与交互能力。

bio.en: The team centers its research on embodied AI world models and physical intelligence, carrying out cutting-edge work across key directions including geometric representation, tactile and force sensing, 4D spatio-temporal modeling, and physics-grounded representation learning. We are now opening applications for Senior Algorithm Interns: you will work alongside our team to explore high-impact foundational problems in embodied intelligence and physical intelligence, and drive rigorous real-world validation and deployment of research outcomes on actual robotic systems.
bio.zh: 团队重点关注具身智能世界模型与物理智能，并围绕几何表征、触觉与力觉、4D时空建模、物理表征学习等方向开展前沿研究。现招聘高级算法实习生，与团队共同探索具身智能与物理智能领域的重要问题，并推动研究成果在真实机器人系统中的验证与落地。

opportunities.en: His current research interests include multimodal physical intelligence models (RSI/VLM/VLA/WAM, etc.), efficient physical AI, safe physical AI, robotic systems, dexterous hands, AI for PDEs, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), high-computing-power controllers, and integrated cloud-computing and control, among others.
opportunities.zh: 他目前的研究兴趣包括，多模态物理智能模型（RSI/VLM/VLA/WAM等）、高效物理AI、安全物理AI、机器人系统、灵巧手、AI4PDE、物理信息神经网路（PINNs）、高算力控制器、网算控一体化等。

opportunities.en: The laboratory has long-term recruitment for postdoctoral researchers, engineers, master's and doctoral interns, and undergraduate interns. At the same time, according to Peking University's enrollment plan, there are several enrollment slots for master's and doctoral students. In addition, the laboratory also collaborates with many domestic and international universities, providing several opportunities for jointly trained master's and doctoral students.
opportunities.zh: 实验室长期招收博士后、工程师、硕博实习生和本科实习生。 同时根据北京大学招生计划，有若干硕士生和博士生招生指标。 除此之外，实验室还与多所国内外高校合作，有若干联合培养硕士生和博士生机会。

opportunities.en: The laboratory has numerous real projects focused on scenarios such as AI infrastructure, industrial robotics, autonomous laboratories, advanced manufacturing, healthcare, urban management, and energy and power. It is well-equipped, has a harmonious team atmosphere, and provides good training conditions for beginners. PhD, master's, and undergraduate students are welcome to join, to explore and grow together.
opportunities.zh: 实验室有较多面向AI基建、工业机器人、自主实验室、高端制造、医疗康养、城市管理和能源电力等场景的真实项目，设备资源充足，团队氛围融洽，新手培养条件较好，欢迎博士生、硕士生、本科生加入，共同探索，共同成长。

opportunities.en: Please send your CV, transcripts, and a short description of your research interests to gpkupilab@pku.edu.cn
opportunities.zh: 请将个人简历、成绩单与简短的研究兴趣说明发送至 gpkupilab@pku.edu.cn。

impact.intro_en: Prof. Pang's innovations have been adopted by world-leading industrial automation products, generating output value of hundreds of millions of euros across the power, process, discrete, and building automation industries.

items.en: Led software & communication of ABB Mobile YuMi — the world's first mobile dual-arm collaborative robot, which brought ABB into the healthcare and e-commerce logistics robot markets (endorsed by Karolinska Hospital, JD, Amazon, Volkswagen, Walmart).

items.en: Led Hitachi Energy WirelessHP — the world's first hybrid wireless-optical UHVDC control technology (HVDC world No.1 market share).

slides.alt: Embodied AI for cable manipulation scenarios
slides.title_zh: 具身智能模型与机器人学习
slides.desc_en: Multimodal embodied foundation models (VLA / world models / PAM), imitation and reinforcement learning for contact-rich manipulation, sim-to-real transfer, and reliable long-horizon task planning through physics-semantics-driven agent clusters (PySAC).
slides.desc_zh: 多模态具身基础模型（VLA / 世界模型 / PAM）、面向富接触操作的模仿与强化学习、仿真到真实的迁移，以及通过物理语义驱动的智能体集群（PySAC）实现可靠的长程任务规划。

slides.desc_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), neural operators for large-scale multi-scale PDE solving, and mechanism–data fusion models that bring physical semantics into learning-based control.
slides.desc_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）、面向大规模多尺度 PDE 求解的神经算子，以及将物理语义引入学习型控制的机理–数据融合模型。

slides.title_zh: 云雾自动化与工业信息物理系统
slides.desc_en: Cloud-Fog Automation (CFA): software-defined, intelligence-native industrial control infrastructure with communication–computing–control co-design, virtualized controllers, converged 5G/6G networks, and functional safety.
slides.desc_zh: 云雾自动化（CFA）：智能原生的软件定义工业控制基础设施，通信–计算–控制协同设计、虚拟化控制器、融合的 5G/6G 网络与功能安全。

slides.title_zh: 机器人系统与工业部署
slides.desc_en: High-dynamic dexterous robotic systems, dexterous hands, embodied toolchains (ETC), embodied model libraries (EML), and edge controllers (ECC) — deployed as reusable process packages for flexible precision manufacturing in semiconductor, aerospace, rail-transit, and new-energy equipment.
slides.desc_zh: 高动态灵巧机器人系统、灵巧手、具身工具链（ETC）、具身模型库（EML）与边缘控制器（ECC）——作为可复用的工艺包部署于半导体、航空航天、轨道交通与新能源装备的柔性精密制造。

papers.cite: Y. Lou et al., "DynamicWAM: Dual-Path Motion Conditioning for World–Action Models in Dynamic Manipulation," Forty-First AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI), 2027, under review.
papers.note_en: Dual-path motion conditioning lifts the DOMINO benchmark success rate from 29.3% (previous SOTA) to 38.2%.
papers.note_zh: 双路径运动条件将 DOMINO 基准成功率从此前 SOTA 的 29.3% 提升至 38.2%。

papers.cite: M. Li et al., "PS-DLO: Property- and Spatially Aware Deformable Linear Object Manipulation Policy" in IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027 under review
papers.note_en: Improves precision from ±1.2 to ±0.15 via encoder debiasing and visual–trajectory cross-attention.
papers.note_zh: 通过编码器去偏与视觉–轨迹交叉注意力，将精度从 ±1.2 提升至 ±0.15。

papers.cite: X. Han et al. "ForceBench: Benchmarking Force Integration for Robotic Manipulation." in IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027 under review
Y. Fu et al., "CableSort: Force-Guided Dual-Arm Sorting of Stacked Cables," RSS 2026 DAROMA Workshop, 2026.
papers.note_en: Instance-mask IoU improved from 0.36 to 0.93 over the strongest segmentation baseline, with 48% end-to-end sorting success.
papers.note_zh: 相较最强分割基线，实例掩码 IoU 由 0.36 提升至 0.93，端到端分拣成功率达 48%。

papers.cite: D. Hu et al., "Spectral-Temporal Conditioning: A Frequency-Domain Framework for Robust Robotic Imitation Learning" in IEEE Transactions on Consumer Electronics, 2026.
papers.note_en: Frequency-domain policy learning lifts long-horizon success rate from 3% to 36%.
papers.note_zh: 频域策略学习将长程任务成功率从 3% 提升至 36%。

papers.cite: Y. Chen et al., "TCSC: Time-Consistent Synchronization and Completion for Bridging the Temporal Sim-to-Real Gap in Embodied Intelligence," in IEEE Transactions on Consumer Electronics, 2026.
papers.note_en: Wasserstein-aware causal synchronization raises task success from ~68% to 75%.
papers.note_zh: 基于 Wasserstein 的因果同步将任务成功率从约 68% 提升至 75%。

papers.note_zh: 真实场景成功率由 44.5% 提升至 67.5%。

papers.note_zh: 通过跨域模块嫁接，扩散训练效率提升 25%。

papers.note_en: Rigid-body demonstration generation yield raised from 55.6% to 93.5%.
papers.note_zh: 刚体示范生成良率由 55.6% 提升至 93.5%。
